title: Custom GIS Dashboard
intro: An interactive web dashboard with maps, filters and charts so your team can explore data on its own.

items.title: Dashboard build
items.desc: Interactive map, filters, search, summary charts and pop-ups, styled to your brand.

terms: 50% deposit to begin; balance due on delivery.
You own all final deliverables, code and data outputs.
policy: Your fixed quote defines exactly what's included.
2 rounds of revisions are included. Extra work is a change order at $95–125/hr, approved by you first.
After delivery you have 7 days to approve or list any issues. No reply means the work is accepted.

Bugs or missed requirements are fixed free, plus a 30-day bug-fix warranty after delivery. The 30-day warranty covers our delivered work as-is. It's void for any part changed by the client or a third party, or affected by changes to third-party services, data sources or hosting we don't manage. We can fix those at our hourly rate.

The deposit is non-refundable once work starts. If you cancel midway, you pay for completed milestones and keep that work. If GeoKnight can't deliver what was quoted, the unfinished portion is refunded.
Month to month, cancel anytime, with an export of your data when you leave.
Raise anything and you'll get a call within 2 business days. Unresolved disputes go to mediation in Duval County, Florida.
